refnamediv.refpurpose: Queries the remote side of the given socket

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
A Socket instance created with socket_create or socket_accept.
address
If the given socket is of type AF_INET or AF_INET6, socket_getpeername will return the peers (remote) IP address in appropriate notation (e.g. 127.0.0.1 or fe80::1) in the address parameter and, if the optional port parameter is present, also the associated port.
If the given socket is of type AF_UNIX, socket_getpeername will return the Unix filesystem path (e.g. /var/run/daemon.sock) in the address parameter. It is an empty string when the peer has no name, for example with socket_create_pair, or when the name is in the abstract namespace.
port
If given, this will hold the port associated to address. It is not written for an AF_UNIX socket.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
&return.success; &false; is returned, with an E_WARNING, when the underlying call fails, for example on a socket that is not connected such as a listening server socket (SOCKET_ENOTCONN), and the last socket error code is updated.
